problems.explain: a = 1, b = 5, c = 5. b² − 4ac = 25 − 4 × 1 × 5 = 5. Into the formula: n = (−(5) ± √5) / (2 × 1) = (−5 ± √5) / 2. Nothing divides out, so n = (−5 ± √5)/2.
